title: Happy Pay Lands $5M Seed Round Led by Partech
excerpt: African fintech startup Happy Pay has successfully closed a $5 million seed funding round, spearheaded by leading venture capital firm Partech. This significant investment underscores growing investor confidence in the continent's rapidly evolving payment solutions sector.
author: Ngozi Okafor

title: Africa Tech Funding Soars 25% in 2025, Driven by Record Debt, Partech Reports
excerpt: African tech startups saw a significant 25% increase in funding in 2025, largely propelled by unprecedented debt financing. A new report from Partech highlights this shift in investment trends across the continent.
author: Naledi Mkhize

title: Saudi Arabia Launches $250M Fund to Boost African Startup Investment

author: Aisha Hassan

title: African Tech: New Funds Emerge for 2026 Pitches

title: Africa's Investment Puzzle: What's Holding Back Private Equity & Venture Capital?

author: Naledi Mokoena
